_help: What the reminders look for. Globs are relative to the project root: ** matches any folders, * any name. While a list is empty its reminder stays quiet. See README.md next to this file.

newSurface._help: newFiles: globs for NEW files that count as new surface, e.g. "src/app/**/page.tsx". addedLines: lines added to existing files that count, e.g. { "files": "src/lib/permissions.ts", "pattern": "^ *([A-Za-z0-9_]+): '", "what": "permission" } (README.md has it ready to copy); the pattern's first group is the name a feature-fit note must mention. notesDir: where the notes live.

docsImpact._help: code: globs for code whose change usually means a doc changes too; docs: globs for those docs. At push, code changed with no doc changed and no Docs-Impact line gets a reminder.
